programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Join Twinkle the star for her most magical moments! When Max, Muffin and Bao Bao build a toy train, Twinkle transforms into a real train and takes the kids on a ride all around the house! Then, when Max pretends he's a wizard, Twinkle turns into a magic wand to make his magic real! Her powers continue as she brings fruits and veggies to life for a puppet show and turns into a giant wibbly-wobbly jelly for everyone to play on! It's always magical with Twinkle!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Celebrate Nature November as Bari learns actions with Grandma Panda, Max naps in a windy hammock, the bus takes friends to the park, and Mia and Maple ride bikes and blow bubbles with Twinkle in the garden.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Get ready for a super creative day of play with Twinkle! First, it's time to get musical! Each toadstool makes a different musical note, allowing Twinkle and Sandy the Seagull to create a musical tune. Then, get creative as Twinkle has fun painting a picture of what she sees. The fun continues as Twinkle shares a box full of super fun toys, and her friends learn how to play new musical instruments!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of discovery and play with Twinkle and her friends! The fun starts as they learn to play new musical instruments, with Twinkle on drums, Kitty on the sax and Bunny on guitar! Then, it's time to play a fun game of 'Twinkle Says'! Follow along as they give you playful instructions and see if you can keep up. The discoveries continue as the friends find a mirror and make funny faces and wonder what an umbrella is for before it starts to rain!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos and clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired and puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to learn about animals, numbers, ABCs and more! Join Kii and Yii as they head to Old MacDonald's farm to learn all the sounds the animals make. Then it's time to learn numbers by singing along and counting the five cute penguins and five little ducks! The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' and an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat and her kitten.

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Join Kii and Yii for songs about feeling good and staying safe! First, learn the best way to get a healthy smile in a fun and educational song about how to brush your teeth properly. Then, learn how to be safe when you're riding a bike at the playground. The lessons continue as Kii and Yii sing about being kind to each other, especially when a friend is sick. From learning colors to singing a soothing lullaby, these songs will make you feel good!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some sci-fi mayhem with Arpo and Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel accidentally switches Arpo to zero-gravity mode, causing the robot and everything he touches to float around the city! Then, Arpo accidentally shrinks Baby Daniel with a shrink ray and has to search frantically for the tiny toddler. The out-of-this-world adventure continues when the pesky squirrel takes Daniel on an unexpected trip to outer space in a make-believe rocket!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns to do the right thing! When Buster accidentally breaks the class flower, he panics and tries to cover it up, but soon learns that telling the truth is always the best thing to do. Then, when he and Daddy spot a steam train speeding out of control, they know they have to do the right thing! They race after the train and save the day! From cleaning up his toys to helping a puppy, Buster is always trying to do the right thing.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as he uses his brains to save the day! When he overloads the carwash with bubble mix, he gets trapped in a giant bubble and floats away! He has to use all his smarts to find a way back down. Then, when Amber the Ambulance crashes and can't move, there's a big emergency! Buster has to muster up his courage and become a 'Hero Ambulance Bus' to save his best friend Scout from a broken bridge.

programme.title: Cody Time

programme.title: CoComelon

programme.title: The Christmas Apprentice
programme.desc: Riley Thomas (Abigail Hawk) is a rising star at one of the world's most noted holding companies. With Christmas fast approaching, she is sent to the small town of Chestnut, Vermont to evaluate the assets of one of their companies, an outerwear clothing manufacturer. As she begins making plans for liquidation, she hires the company's founder, Nick (Howard Hesseman)-now retired-as her apprentice to help. Of course, everyone assumes she's there to save the company and she keeps her true motives a secret. In the process, she comes to appreciate what the company means to the small town; and she falls in love with its youthful CEO, Wyatt (David O'Donnell). She slowly comes to embrace the small town's values and even helps create a new product line just in time for Christmas. As her priorities change and her love grows, will Riley be able to stand up to her boss, Preston Bullock (Chevy Chase) and save the company she was supposed to destroy?

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Playing Golf: George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Lots of Muddy Puddles: On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Being Babies: Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Dr Hamster's Ant Farm: Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom! (S8, ep 22)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Granny Sheep Moves In: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack: Grampy Rabbit's new jet pack shoots off into the distance and he ends up on top of a snowy mountain! (S5, ep 37)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Park: Peppa Pig goes to the park to play with friends and have new experiences.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Parking Ticket: When Daddy Pig gets a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that grown-ups have rules just like children - and get told off too!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Big Hill: When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Run Daddy Run: Daddy Pig thinks perhaps he should run the London Marathon to teach his children about determination! Daddy enlists Peppa and George to help with training in the park. (S8, ep 24)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Hobbies: Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do. (S8, ep 6)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Decorating: With the building work done, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick? (S8, ep 3)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Space Adventure!: It is back to Granny Pig's historical re-enactment society for a space adventure, as Peppa and George re-enact the Apollo moon landing.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig's Metal Detector: Grandpa can't find his old metal detector to look for the key for George's new toy robot lost in the long grass.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Parachute Games: During playgroup, Madame Gazelle takes everyone outside to play Parachute Games.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Marathon: It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy! (S8, ep 26)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa's Office: Mummy and Daddy Pig are working in their home office and Peppa wants to 'work' like them too. Peppa decides that she needs her own office, so she takes the cupboard under the stairs.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Bug Hotel: During another visit to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house, Grandpa takes everyone to show them the new Bug Hotel he is building.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Poems: Madame Gazelle introduces the playgroup to the wonderful world of poetry - and the wonderful world of wooly socks!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Buried Treasure: Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Kiddie Workout: At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Club House: Mr Bull builds a brand-new club house and slide for Peppa and her friends.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: What Babies Do: Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's House to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa learns babies are not like dolls at all, and do lots of things every day.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Jumping Stick: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick and tries to show how to use it, but finds it difficult. Peppa and her friends struggle too. But there's always jumping in muddy puddles! (S7, ep 23)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Jukebox: Peppa and George have been sailing with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Back at the clubhouse, they discover a jukebox - but it is very noisy!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Petting Farm: Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Monkey Trees: Peppa and her family are visiting an adventure park. Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they have fun working their way around an obstacle course.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Moving In: Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the apartment. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino. (S7, ep 32)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Hearing Test: Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss and suggests George tries a hearing aid. (S8, ep 14)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: House Rules: While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Health Check: Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and more.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Super Potato Movie: Peppa and her friends visit visit the cinema for the first time to watch the Super Potato movie!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Long Grass: Daddy Pig has not cut the lawn for ages and the grass has grown very long.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: George's New Dinosaur: George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur breaks. With all the additional features surely Dino Roar is a good replacement?

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Fruit: It is fruit day at the supermarket, and Miss Rabbit is making fruit smoothies.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Snow: Peppa and George have fun in the snow. They make footprints, play snowballs and build a snowman.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Daddy Puts Up A Picture: Mummy Pig has a nice new picture of Peppa and George. Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but the job is not as simple as he thought and soon there is a very big hole in the wall.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Goldie The Fish: Goldie the Fish does not look happy and isn't eating her food, so Peppa, George and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the Vet.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Pen Pal: Peppa has a pen pal! Peppa gets letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they love lots of the same things!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Wishing Well: Granny Pig places a large order of plastic gnomes and a wishing well for the garden, Peppa and George love them but Grandpa Pig is not happy. He wishes they would all disappear!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Canal Boat: It's Captain Daddy Dog's birthday and Mummy Dog surprises him with the gift of a boat trip, which isn't quite what he had expected.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Stars: It is night time and the sky is full of shining stars. Just this once, Mummy and Daddy Pig go outside to look at the stars. Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Desert Island: When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. He realises he misses the sea!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Secrets: Mummy Pig gives Peppa a special box to keep secret things in.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Best Friend: Peppa loves playing doctors and nurses with her best friend, Suzy Sheep, and George loves being the patient!

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: A mind-bending psychological thriller about a group of friends who find themselves in a sadistic, living nightmare. Six adventurous strangers travel to a mysterious building to experience a game where players compete to solve puzzles to win money. But what starts out as innocent fun soon turns into a suffocating and terrifying game of hell.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Escape or die in this star studded thriller featuring Cameron Monaghan (Gotham), Frank Grillo (The Purge: Anarchy) and Academy Award Nominee John Malkovich (Being John Malkovich). Chris has everything but the woman of his dreams. Enter Sky to help Chris move on from his divorce; but fine wine and chemistry wont save him from Skys true intention

programme.title: Devils of War
programme.desc: Poland 1944. A daring team of Special Forces soldiers are called by President Roosevelt. Their top-secret rescue mission, to stage a daring raid on a fortress, where the Nazis are kidnapping women and experimenting with the occult to raise a demon army. But the soldiers soon find themselves trapped deep behind enemy lines in deadly circumstances.

programme.title: June
programme.desc: Dark. Demonic. Disturbing. Nine-year-old orphan June has been found a new adoptive family. What her new parents do not know is that June is possessed by an ancient dark spirit named Aer. As the evil Aer plans to destroy everything, will June be able to save her new family and herself? In the vein of The Omen and Orphan, this chilling supernatural cult horror is a genre classic and one not to miss.

programme.title: Frightfest
programme.desc: From FrightFest Presents. The producer of Sin City: A Dame to Kill For brings you this blood-spattered descent into the depths of hell. Blood runs rampant on Halloween Night when a small towns Fright Fest turns all too real in an abandoned state asylum. When a van of criminally insane prisoners crashes nearby, the trick or treaters think their murderous acts are part of the show!

programme.title: Salt Beef and Rye
programme.desc: This vibrant documentary is inspired by the colourful characters who frequent the world famous Brick Lane. London's reputation as the cultural hub of the world can be attributed in part to its deep-rooted history and diverse communities. Salt Beef & Rye takes audiences on a tour through one of the city's most influential streets.

programme.title: Christmas Eve
programme.desc: Hilarity, romance and festive spirit prevail, when six New Yorkers get trapped in an elevator on Christmas Eve! Forcing the likes of a heartless real estate tycoon (Patrick Stewart- X-Men), a crass HR manager (Max Casella- The Sopranos), his ex-employee (Jon Heder- Napoleon Dynamite) and a cynical doctor (Gary Cole- Pineapple Express) to reconsider the way they think about others.

programme.title: Crossing the Line
programme.desc: From the team behind Oscar winners La La Land and Call Me by Your Name. This modern Western showcases breathtaking performances by Tessa Thompson and Lily James, who portray sisters forced into a life of crime to save their family. Faced with betrayal and violence, they risk everything on a drug smuggling mission. A brutally fresh look at all of Americas ills. Winters Bone meets Frozen River.

programme.title: The Senator
programme.desc: Starring Jason Clarke, Kate Mara and Ed Helms, this shocking political thriller follows a tragic web of lies that took hold of the Kennedy family and forever changed the course of US history. On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drove his car off a bridge on Massachusetts Chappaquiddick Island, causing the death of Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: The night Abigail (Christina Ricci) meets Ben (Hamish Linklater) at a bar, they jokingly come up with a list of things to do before their imagined breakup, knowingly full well theyll never even start a relationship. But when the joke turns in to a one-night stand things become a whole lot more complicated.

programme.title: Reclaim
programme.desc: Starring Ryan Phillippe, Rachelle Lefevre and John Cusack. Steven and Shannon risk their lives to reveal the truth behind their newly adopted daughter's disappearance. They soon discover that all is not what it seems when they uncover a high-stakes underground child trafficking scam, which sends them on a high octane mission of retribution. How far will they go to save their daughter?

programme.title: The Bronx Bull
programme.desc: Based on awe-inspiring true events, this epic 'rags to riches' tale recounts the story of young boxer Jake LaMotta as he struggles to get to the top of his game. Featuring an award-winning cast starring William Forsythe (The Rock), Paul Sorvino (Goodfellas), Tom Sizemore (Saving Private Ryan), Penelope Ann Miller (The Artist), Natasha Henstridge and Ray Wise (RoboCop).

programme.title: The Reef: Stalked
programme.desc: After Nic and Annie witness the horrific murder of their sister, they try to escape the trauma by traveling to a remote Pacific Island for a kayaking adventure. But within hours of arriving, the women are attacked far from land by a great white shark. Bleeding, vulnerable and with their lives at stake, its a fight for survival when they realise that theyre being stalked by the deadly beast.

programme.title: Rupture
programme.desc: Young mother Renee (Noomi Rapace, The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo) is randomly abducted and taken to a secret lab, where she is traumatically experimented on. She must uncover why she is chosen and escape her prison. Also starring Michael Chiklis (The Shield), Peter Stormare (Fargo) and Lesley Manville (Maleficent). A brilliantly disorientating thriller from the acclaimed Director of (Secretary).

programme.title: Bar Fight!
programme.desc: Time to settle the score, one drink at a time. Theres only one way to assert dominance after a break up and for Nina (Melissa Fumero, Brooklyn Nine-Nine) and Allen (Luka Jones, Up All Night) its a turf war for their local watering hole. Lines have been drawn and with the help of Ninas best friend Chelsea (Rachel Bloom, Crazy Ex-Girlfriend) its going to be a winner takes all affair.

programme.title: Bar Fight!
programme.desc: Time to settle the score, one drink at a time. Theres only one way to assert dominance after a break up and for Nina (Melissa Fumero, Brooklyn Nine-Nine) and Allen (Luka Jones, Up All Night) its a turf war for their local watering hole. Lines have been drawn and with the help of Ninas best friend Chelsea (Rachel Bloom, Crazy Ex-Girlfriend) its going to be a winner takes all affair.

programme.title: Mara
programme.desc: A twisted, spine-tingling horror based on the ancient legend of the night hag demon - Mara. Criminal psychologist Kate (Olga Kurylenko: Quantum of Solace) is assigned to the murder of a man who has seemingly been strangled in his sleep by his wife and the only witness is their daughter. As Kate investigates she experiences the same petrifying symptoms and spirals through a chilling nightmare.

programme.title: Romulus v. Remus: The First King
programme.desc: Vikings meets Game of Thrones meets Apocolypto, this historical action epic is the legendary story of two brothers who battled to found the greatest empire history has ever known; Rome. With stunning visuals and immersive epic battle scenes, follow Romulus and Remus as they escape captivity, battle sacred fire and violent warriors, leading one of them seal his fate as the chosen one.

programme.title: Rise of the Krays
programme.desc: The early years of the two of the most notorious British criminals are portrayed in visceral brutality. London, 1961: Ronnie and Reggie Kray begin a reign of terror that would define London's East End for years to come. From protection rackets to members' clubs, street brawls to arson via blackmail extending all the way up to the Cabinet Office, the Krays rained red on anyone who crossed them.

programme.title: Fall of a Kingdom
programme.desc: Game of Thrones meets Braveheart. This historical actioner follows a 13th century freedom fighters as they battle for their lives and liberty in the face of the brutal Mongolian Empire. As war breaks out, both sides suffer devastation. Redoubling his efforts, Burunda Khan the Mongolian general - unleashes the full fury of his force. Starring Robert Patrick, Tommy Flanagan and Poppy Drayton.

programme.title: My Zoe
programme.desc: An emotionally-engaging, heartbreaking family drama with a dystopian sci-fi twist, starring Julie Delpy (Before Sunrise), Richard Armitage (The Stranger), Gemma Arterton (Summerland) and Daniel Brhl (Captain America: Civil War). Top-level scientist Isabelle is forced to stay in contact with her ex as they are co-parent their daughter and when tragedy strikes she takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Standing Up Falling Down
programme.desc: After four years of chasing his stand-up comedy dream in Los Angeles, 34-year old Scott Rollins has crashed and burned. On a night out, Scott strikes up an unlikely friendship with an eccentric dermatologist, Marty. As their relationship evolves, they realise they need to find the strength to start confronting their long-simmering regrets.

programme.title: My Days of Mercy
programme.desc: A heart-wrenching tale of finding love in the least-likely of places. Starring Academy Award nominee Elliot Page (The Umbrella Academy) and Kate Mara (TVs House of Cards). Two women from opposite sides of fierce protests meet on the picket lines and form an unlikely friendship. While dealing with their respective issues they grow ever closer, leading to a life changing romance.

programme.title: Slightly Single in LA
programme.desc: Fun, flirty and downright outrageous. Independent, LA singleton Dale (Lacey Chabert, Mean Girls) is sick and tired of her troublesome love life. On the verge of giving up, she is reunited with an old friend - successful heartthrob and rock star Zach. Is this Dale's lucky chance to fall in love? Also starring Jenna Dewan (Step Up) and Jonathan Bennett (Mean Girls). Perfect for a girls night in!

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles
programme.desc: The true story of Scottish Olympic runner, Eric Liddell, who was captured by the Japanese, during WWII. In a concentration camp, he experienced a world of torture and cruelty and was forced to resort to one final decision to ensure his survival.

programme.title: You Are Not My Mother
programme.desc: It's the week before Halloween and Chars mother, Angela, has inexplicably disappeared. All that remains is her abandoned car. When she returns home without explanation, it becomes clear to Char and her grandmother, Rita, that something is amiss. She might look and sound the same but Angelas behaviour has become increasingly frightening, as if she has been replaced by a malevolent force.

programme.title: The Wicker Man
programme.desc: Based on the hit thriller of the same name and starring Nicolas Cage, this cult classic returns 15 years after its original release. A man finds himself sucked into a twisted community whose secrets and Puritan ways could see a young girl sacrificed. It’s a race against time for this outsider to save a life but the residents of Summers Isle may just have other plans.

programme.title: The Ledge
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat survival thriller starring Brittany Ashworth (Hostile) and Ben Lamb (Divergent). When Kelly captures the murder of her best friend on camera while on a rock climbing trip, she becomes the next target of a group of friends who will stop at nothing to destroy the evidence. Kelly finds herself in a free-climbing chase up a freezing mountain, pursued by the group of murderous men.

programme.title: Blind
programme.desc: After losing her vision in a freak accident, former actress Faye is living alone in her dream home. Struggling to come to terms with her lost career and new life without sight, she soon gets the uneasy feeling that all is not right with her new world. But when a masked stranger shows up and moves in; Faye soon begins to realise she is far from alone.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are in Honolulu (hoping for two weeks of sun, surf and no assignments) when they receive a call from Charlie advising that Congressman Knight's son, David, honeymooning with his wife, Marti, has been attacked while moonlight picnicking on the beach. David is critically injured and Marti is missing. The Angels pass all the tests -- sign on as lifeguards. Marti has been kidnapped and terrorized by three toughs who hold her in a secluded beach house. The three men later ram the legs of Kris' lifeguard stand with their vehicle but Kelly and Julie arrive in time to save her as the toughs escape. Bosley finds that there have been other complaints of beach assaults and the Angels recognize, from the pictures, the three who tried to attack Kris. Ted, one of the men, unbeknownst to the other two, takes Marti out of the beach house and drives to a phone where he calls Bosley with a ransom offer. Meanwhile, Marti gets away and into a shopping center where she is spotted wandering in a daze and is rescued by the Angels. The other two men discover what Ted has done and kill him. Later, Kris and Kelly are picked up and taken by the two toughs to the beach house. Kelly gets to her radio (while the two have Kris in another room) and reaches Bosley and Julie who come to the rescue and apprehend the kidnappers. David and Marti are well on their way to full recovery.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Steve Moss, owner of the Tropicana nightclub in Honolulu, is kidnapped, after firing young dancer, Donna Lindsey. He is taken in a van to a warehouse, where he is put into a cage with 60's rock music blaring in his ears. One of the specialties of his club is dancers in cages performing to 60's rock music. Steve is known as a hard taskmaster and is disliked by his dancers, particularly head dance show director, Stacy Parrish. A ransom note appears asking for $1 million with a note saying there will be one dancer missing each day until it is paid. Much to the surprise of everyone, Marian Moss, Steve's wife, advises that she doesn't have the $1 million asked. Since the Tropicana has been a lucrative nightclub, the Angels and Bosley (in various disguises) investigate and find through Donna Lindsey that Moss was really helping the young girls who couldn't make it in show business, and that is where the money went. They also discover that Stacy was a girlfriend of Moss before he met Marian and Stacy has staged the whole thing. They locate the warehouse where Moss is being kept and where Julie has also been taken. The two are freed and Stacy is taken into custody.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are sent to Moonshine country in the Deep South to investigate problems between long-feuding bootlegging families, the Bartletts and the Catlins. Son, Bobby Dan Bartlett, who is injured trying to get a shipment of whiskey to market and Catlin daughter, Melinda, are in love, much to the displeasure of both families. Kris gets a job with the Catlins as a still master. Kelly gets a job with the Bartletts as a driver. Julie takes a job as a waitress at Joe's Diner. Bosley poses as a wealthy southerner trying to buy both families out. The Angels find that the shootings and hijackings have not been done by the families, but by a group headed by Max Lacy from New York. Lacy is trying to corner the whiskey market and gain political control of the state. The Angels are able to stop a gunfight between the family elders, Hawkshaw Bartlett and Bluford Catlin, and show them who the real culprits are. Max Lacy and his group are arrested. Hobby Dan and Melinda are happily reunited.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Barbara Stone and her sister, Jane, to track down John Thornwood. He has swindled them out of $100,000 by promising to marry Jane and persuading her to invest money in a phony South American oil exploration venture. The Angels track Thornwood to an apartment complex. Kris, posing as a confidence artist, rents the apartment next to his. Bosley poses as a Texan from whom she has swindled $50,000. Kris and Thornwood become friends, and he confesses to her that he has another scheme going. Kelly and Julie follow Thornwood to a museum owned by plain-looking Monica Thackery. Thornwood is posing as Professor Thornwood and has asked the smitten Monica to marry him and deposit $150,000 to an account supposedly for importing some pieces of art. Charlie, Bosley and the Angels find that Monica is the daughter of an eastern syndicate head, Joe Fenell. Thornwood is planning a phony marriage ceremony with Monica and then to withdraw the money and run. The Angels trick Thornwood into a real marriage with Monica because she is so much in love with him. They figure that her father will keep Thornwood in line. Thornwood, finding that he has been tricked, tries to escape, but is caught by Joe Fenell and his henchmen. Fenell warns him to be good to Monica or else. Thornwood knows that he has to stick with Monica and be a good husband...or else.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are called in to investigate, when Tom Archer, who owns a cab company with his wife Laurie, is badly burned as his cab explodes. Laurie Archer reveals that they have been getting threatening phone calls and someone obviously is trying to put them out of business. Kris takes a job as a waitress across the street from the cab garage. Julie becomes a driver and Kelly, a dispatcher. Two employees, Jake Barnett, ex-con, and Sarge, a shell-shocked hallucinating casualty of World War II, are both under suspicion. It seems Tom Archer had fired Sarge and advised him to go to the V.A. hospital for treatment. Later, Julie's cab catches fire and she and her passenger escape just in time. Jake advises Julie that Sarge's ex-wife was killed by a cab and he is starting the fires to put Tom and Laurie's cab company out of business. The Angels go to Sarge's room, but he escapes through a window, goes up on the roof, and tries to jump to the next building. He misses and is killed. The Angels then find out that Sarge's wife was not killed by a cab. Instead, the woman who Jake lived with was the victim of the accident. Julie takes Jake out in her cab with a tape recorder on -- the others listening -- and gets Jake to admit that he is really the guilty one. He takes off in the cab -- Kris arrives and she and Julie pursue him and trap him at the Los Angeles River. The other Angels praise Julie for her driving expertise and she admits she learned it from an old boyfriend in her neighborhood who drove stolen cars.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Mary and her very attractive friend, Lois, go to the Hot Line Club, a singles club with a phone at each table. The phone rings and the caller asks to speak to Lois. He then tells her that she is so pretty he has to kill her. Lois leaves the club. She is followed, and in an effort to escape, runs in front of a car, is hit and killed. Mary calls in the Angels to investigate. They all go to the Hot Line Club. The entertainment is hypnotist, Margo, who gets Kelly into the act. Kelly later gives Margo her business card. Afterwards, Kelly sits with Mary. Soon the phone rings and Mary answers. The voice asks to speak with Kelly. When she gets on, he tells her that she is so pretty he has to kill her. Mary recognizes it as the same voice that called Lois. When Kelly leaves the club, she sees a car following her and writes down the license number. Later she is contacted by a man named Edward Ford who says he is a writer. He tells Kelly that Margo gave him her name and number. They arrange to meet for lunch. Kelly is suspicious of him and contacts the other Angels who find out that his car is registered in the name of Paul Factor. Kelly leaves the luncheon and goes back to the Hot Line Club in an effort to get information about Ford from Margo. When Margo arrives, she takes Kelly out to a back alley, pulls a knife and tries to stab her. The Angels and Bosley arrive in time to rescue her. During the struggle, Margo's wig and false eyelashes come off, revealing "her" to be Edward Ford who really is Paul Factor.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Ruth Traina, who has invested $150,000 in a Darian Mason Production, to investigate the disappearance of two of the best dancers. Kelly auditions a job as a dancer; Julie is her agent/manager and Kris poses as a writer/critic doing a story on Mason. Another of the better dancers, Nancy, disappears after being caught going through Mason's files. Mason then catches Kris going through his files and threatens her. The Angels and Bosley find that Mason has deliberately hired theinexperienced and gotten rid of the good ones to make the audition a failure, since he can't possibly pay off all of his investors. Kelly and Julie come to Kris' rescue. They then find and free the three missing dancers. The cast, including Kelly, decide to go through the audition since they feel that they owe it to themselves to at least try. The Las Vegas executives they audition for express great interest in the dancers.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Motion picture executive Jonathan Tobias hires Bosley and the Angels to track down someone dressed as one of Robin Hood's Merry Men who has been shooting arrows into studio personnel. Tobias knows that the arrows are aimed at him when his chauffeur is hit. Charlie arranges for the Angels to enroll in stunt school and then go to work as stuntwomen on a picture called "Marian and her Merry Maids" -- a bad remake of an old Errol Flynn classic. The Angels become friendly with one of the maids, Ellen Travers, and her husband, Jeff. Ellen, a former rodeo queen, has become enamored with movies. Jeff is trying desperately to get her to quit the movies and go back home with him. Bosley learns that one of the security guards, Jake Webner, was in the original picture with his idol -- Errol Flynn. Ellen Travers is hit with an arrow while driving a wagon during one of the scenes. It is Jake who has been dressing as Robin Hood's man with the bow and arrow, trying to get to Tobias because he feels that Tobias has been making bad movies. Jake is eventually caught while shooting an arrow into the director's foot. However, Bosley discovers that Jake was on guard duty when Ellen Travers was shot. Her husband, Jeff, who was trying to scare her into giving up movies, really shot her. Jake and Jeff are both taken into custody.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Edward Tustin, head of a group trying to take over Western Techtronics, engages efficiency expert, Dr. John Reardon of Executive Assistants, to have the four members of Techtronics who oppose his takeover killed. Reardon has hypnotized three girls for the job; Darlene Warren, Cynthia Weaver and Francine Miller. He uses motivational Pavlovian and Sensory conditioning and the subjects kill without fear, passion or memory. After the Chairman of the Board and a Vice President of Techtronics are killed and Francine Miller's body is found with them, the Angels are hired by company President, Steve Briggs. Briggs realizes he is next on the list. Kelly and Kris join Techtronics as executive trainees and Julie applies as Executive Assistant. She is hypnotized by Dr. Reardon, who uses flashing strobe effects, a candle and a water tank. After Julie has become completely programmed, she is sent to kill Briggs and almost succeeds when the suspicious Kelly and Kris arrive and save him. Julie is then deprogrammed by a doctor who explains that fire and water are two of the strongest hypnotic symbols. Reardon, Tustin and their associates are taken into custody.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: After twelve different banks have been robbed of a quarter of a million dollars in hundred dollar bills, the Angels are called in to investigate. All the banks have the same type of automatic teller. Ted Markham, a computer and electronics genius who designed and installed the automatic tellers, has quit his job. Kris volunteers to become acquainted with Markham with the intention of obtaining some of the bills so that the serial numbers may be traced. Kris follows Markham to a poker parlor where he takes out a stack of $100 bills and with the help of a wrist calculator is a big winner. Ted and Kris are attracted to each other and they take off for Las Vegas in Kris' car. While in Las Vegas, Kris manages to get some of the bills away from Ted. She phones the serial numbers to Bosley and soon learns that they are part of the missing money. After Ted has won $300,000, he is asked to leave Las Vegas by the casino owner. On the way out of town, Ted stops at a bank while Kris waits in the car. When they arrive back in California, at the spot where Ted left his car, Kelly, Julie and Bosley are waiting with the police to take Ted into custody. Bosley then finds that Ted is free to go due to the fact that when he deposited the money in the bank in Las Vegas, he had paid back each of the twelve banks with interest, and they will not prosecute. Even though Ted and Kris have strong feelings for each other, they realize their relationship would not be the same -- so they sadly part.

Now, she must return home to spearhead the renovation of a derelict hotel, which must be restored in time for a Christmas Eve benefit dance performance. But Laura is shocked to learn that her old love, Ricardo Archuleta, the boy who jilted her for a professional dance career, is the star of the dance benefit. And when his dance partner Taylor walks out on the show for an out-of-town audition, Laura has to step in for her, reawakening her love of the dance, not to mention her old feelings for Ricardo -- a potent combination that has her head spinning.

programme.desc: : Donal MacIntyre meets Detective Chief Inspector Martin Brunning to discover how he solved the murder of Vitalija Baliutaviciene by her jilted ex-husband in Peterborough.

programme.title: UK Crime Files: Red Signs to Murder
programme.desc: : Just fourteen days after being released, Matthew Williams, a prolific offender with a long history of violence, stabbed a woman to death in the South Wales valleys.

programme.title: UK Crime Files: Body at the Airport
programme.desc: : A woman's body is found in a suitcase in a car park at Heathrow Airport. Detectives have no idea they're about to launch a decade long investigation.

programme.title: UK Crime Files: The Moors Murders
programme.desc: : Simon Toyne travels the north of England to investigate the crimes committed by Ian Brady and Myra Hindley, which resulted in the death of five children.

programme.title: Man Who Cheated Himself
programme.desc: 1950. Crime. Director: Felix E. Feist. Stars Lee J. Cobb, Jane Wyatt & John Dall. A homicide detective who witnesses his girlfriend kill her husband is assigned to the case, alongside his brother. [S]

programme.title: Portraits of Terror
programme.desc: 1957. Horror. Directed by Ed Wood Jr. Stars James 'Duke' Moore, Dudley Manlove & Jeannie Stevens. An actor roams an empty theatre after dark, where he is haunted by creepy sounds and eerie sights. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Stage Door Johnnie. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Cicely Courtneidge. Kate Seymour is engaged to James Stratton, but she is receiving letters warning of his womanising. [S]

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed Wimbledon Hastings? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. An exploding tennis ball kill a tennis star at a charity event. Time for Burke to investigate.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Cat's Meow. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward, Julie Newmar & Sharyn Wynters. Catwoman steals Chad and Jeremy's voices and holds them for ransom. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Bat's Kow Tow. 1966. Stars Adam West, Julie Newmar & Ric Roman. Batman and Robin rush to the Policeman's Ball where Chad and Jeremy are singing but Catwoman is already there to cause mayhem. [S]

programme.title: The Marked One
programme.desc: 1963. Crime. Director: Francis Searle. Stars William Lucas, Zena Walker & Patrick Jordan. Criminals kidnap a man's daughter in order to obtain forgery plates which they believe he possesses. [S]

programme.title: The Agitator
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Director: John Harlow. Stars William Hartnell, Mary Morris & John Laurie. In this 'lost' William Hartnell film, a socialist inherits the British factory where he works as a union mechanic

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: Death on the Underground. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. The murder of 73 year old aristocrat Countess Teresa Lubienska on the eastbound Piccadilly line platform in 1957. [S]

programme.title: Paid
programme.desc: 1930. Drama. Directed by Sam Wood. Stars Joan Crawford, Robert Armstrong & Marie Prevost. Mary Turner, a wrongly accused ex-convict, seeks revenge on those who sent her to prison. [S]

programme.title: Inspector Hornleigh
programme.desc: 1938. Mystery. Directed by Eugene Forde. Stars Gordon Harker, Alastair Sim & Miki Hood. Inspector Hornleigh is called in to investigate a murder linked to the theft of government secrets. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1953. The Missing Man. Directed by Ken Hughes. Stars Tristan Rawson & Evelyn Moore. The Dream of a Retired Vicar's wife sets police on the trail of a man who has been missing since 1938. (S1, E02)

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Knight Who Came To Dinner. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Little John and Friar Tuck capture a knight, but are concerned about his value judging by his equipment. [S]

programme.title: Doctor at Sea
programme.desc: 1955. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Brigitte Bardot, James Robertson. A young man signs up to be a ship's doctor in an effort to bring some excitement into his life. [S]

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Diamond Studded Malaria. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Bill Nagy. Bill Harrison has just been acquitted of murder. He was escorting diamonds to London but came down with malaria. [S]

programme.title: A Family At War: Christmas Special
programme.desc: 1971. Salute The Happy Morn. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Mrs Porter discovers the truth about Margaret's illegitimate child. Sheila has designs on Colin. (S2, E17) [S]

programme.title: Nowhere To Go
programme.desc: 1958. Crime. Directors: Seth Holt, Basil Dearden. Stars George Nader, Maggie Smith, Bernard Lee. Paul is released from jail, following a stretch for robbing a woman who falls for his charms. [S]

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1975. They All Sound Simple at First. Stars Alfred Burke, Peter Childs & Philip Madoc. Marker is called in by a cabinet-maker to recover £700 he's owed for an antique clock. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Join Caroline Munro as she introduces a unique live event - The Cellar Club Live, featuring fellow Scream Queens Madeline Smith and Judy Matheson. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club Live (Scream Queens)
programme.desc: 2026. Actress and novelist Linda Regan is joined by the fabulous Scream Queens Caroline Munro, Judy Matheson and Madeline Smith, and look into the psychology of horror with Katie Evans. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Before Caroline leaves tonight, let her tell you about the classic film coming up in next week's Cellar Club. [S]

programme.title: Assault
programme.desc: 1971. Thriller. Director: Sidney Hayers. Stars Suzy Kendall, Frank Finlay, Freddie Jones. After two schoolgirls are assaulted in the woods, a teacher uses herself as bait to catch the perpetrator. [S]

programme.title: The Strange Case of Sherlock...
programme.desc: ...Holmes and Arthur Conan Doyle. 2005. Drama. Director: Cilla Ware. Stars Douglas Henshall, Brian Cox & Emily Blunt. The story of Conan Doyle's remarkable life and the birth of Sherlock Holmes. [S]

programme.title: Ghosts on the Loose
programme.desc: 1943. Comedy. Stars Bela Lugosi & Ava Gardner. The East Side Kids try to fix up a house for newlyweds, but find the place next door 'haunted' by mysterious men. [S]

programme.title: 1960s London - Glimpses
programme.desc: 1960s Life in England we particularly look at London in this great montage of clips from more of our favourite 1960s films along with remembering the fashions the songs the cars and the music.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Serpent Beneath. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dennis Price & Zena Marshall. A renowned playwright becomes stale so he steals the play of an unknown author which gets him involved in complications. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Puzzles are Coming. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. The Puzzler tries to fool Knab while the Dynamic Duo hunt the truth, but The Puzzler plans to stop their search. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Duo is Slumming. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & William Dozier. The Puzzler is trying to hijack Knab's plane and hold it for ransom, but Batman and Robin find clues left behind. [S]

programme.title: I Lived With You
programme.desc: 1933. Drama. Stars: Ursula Jeans, Ida Lupino & Minnie Rayner. A penniless Russian Prince is befriended by Gladys who takes him home to live with her folks. Co-written by Ivor Novello. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1960. The Dover Road Mystery. Directed by Gerard Bryant. Starring Geoffrey Keen, Edward Cast and Leonard Sachs. A stolen car used in a bank robbery proves too fast for the squad car. (S1, E32)

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Killer. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Accused of murdering a partisan helper and stealing his gold, Tell must find a way to prove his innocence. [S]

programme.title: Object Z
programme.desc: The World in Fear. 1965. Stars Margaret Neale, Brandon Brady & Terence Donovan. The British public begin to build shelters. Meanwhile in Australia, a 1000 mega ton bomb is launched at Object Z. [S]

programme.title: William at the Circus
programme.desc: Lost Cinema Serial - Episode 2. 1948. Stars William Graham, Garry Marsh & Jane Welsh. William attempts to raise money to ensure all the boys can go on a trip to London to visit Downing Street. [S]

programme.title: There Was An Old Woman Who...
programme.desc: ...Lived In A Shoe. 1940. A wonderful animated short film directed by George Pal featuring a twist on the classic nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: The Morristown Story. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & George Barnes. Hawkeye has tracked outlaw Simon Girty to Morristown but he and Chingachgook are turned away. [S]

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Renegades. 1949. Stars: Clayton Moore, Jay Silverheels & Gene Roth. While on the trail, Tonto gets an urgent message to meet Chief Swift Eagle. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Trapped in the Depths. 1961. Stars David Graham & Graydon Gould. The US Navy are testing a new bathyscaphe when disaster strikes. The Supercar team spring into action to save the trapped crew. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Mystery of Ireland's Eye. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Eddie Byrne & Nigel Davenport. Robin and Friar Tuck escort Marian to Ireland to search for her uncle and encounter a monstrous priest. [S]

programme.title: Zontar - Thing From Venus
programme.desc: 1967. Sci-fi. Directed by Larry Buchanan. Stars John Agar, Susan Bjurman & Tony Huston. A young scientist believes an alien from Venus can help Earth but soon discovers it has a malevolent plan. [S]

programme.title: The Blue Lamp
programme.desc: 1949. Crime. Directed by Basil Dearden. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Jack Warner & Jimmy Hanley. A killer shoots a London policeman during a robbery. [S]

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1966. Company of Fools. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Barrie Ingham. Five strangers band together to exact revenge on a man who ruined them financially. [S] (S1, E10)

programme.title: Three Coins in the Fountain
programme.desc: 1954. Romantic Comedy. Director: Jean Negulesco. Stars Dorothy McGuire & Jean Peters. Three women toss coins into Rome's Trevi Fountain for luck in romance. But none have the luck they hoped for! [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Caught in the Cold
programme.desc: 1963. A look at the chaos brought in by ice and snow each year in Britain, why it happens in an age of scientific miracles and what is being done about it.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Hanging. 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Jennie Linden. Turpin and Swiftnick try to help a mysterious woman who is being blackmailed by Captain Spiker, but they are led into a trap. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Reluctant Witnesses. 1962. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Neville Jason. An old, dilapidated mansion is burgled and Maigret discovers a disturbing reason why a family is reluctant to talk. [S]

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: Let Them Say. 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Denis Lill & Ann Firbank. Visiting Crown Prince Rudolf becomes smitten with Lillie, prompting Bertie to arrange for Lillie to be presented to the Queen. [S]

programme.title: The Paper Chase
programme.desc: 1973. Comedy Drama. Directed by James Bridges. Stars Timothy Bottoms, Lindsay Wagner & John Houseman. A law student learns that his tyrannical professor is also the father of the student he loves. [S]

programme.sub-title: The Dark Spirit Revealed: Yugi Vs. Bakura, Part 3

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: In the second duel of the Battle City Finals, Odion, disguised as Marik, befuddles Joey with numerous traps to bring the duel to a stalemate. However, Joey has Giant Trunade, the perfect counter to Odion’s strategy that guarantees Joey victory… or is Joey falling into another trap?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion’s Embodiments of Apophis run roughshod over Joey’s monsters… and his life points! Can Joey effectively utilize the monsters he won earlier in the tournament, or is he already too flustered to mount a successful counterattack?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: It’s a feeding frenzy as Odion’s Serket devours Joey’s monsters to morph into greater and powerful stages of evolution! How can Joey defeat Serket when it ingests Joey’s monsters whenever they’re summoned on to the field?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 2
programme.desc: As Mai loses more and more of her memories under Marik’s relentless assault, she loses confidence in her dueling abilities. Will Yugi and friends’ neverending support bring her back to victory, or will her shattered mind be trapped in the Shadow Realm for eternity?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 3
programme.desc: Mai gains control of Marik’s The Winged Dragon of Ra, but she’s unable to decipher how to unleash its massively powerful abilities! Can Mai solve the mystery of the Egyptian God Card before Marik solves it himself and incinerates Mai with the full fury of The Winged Dragon of Ra?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 1
programme.desc: In the fourth duel of the Battle City Finals, Kaiba’s mystery opponent is… Ishizu! With the power of her Millennium Necklace, Ishizu can see the future, including every card Kaiba is planning to play! Does Kaiba stand a chance against an opponent who knows his moves even before he does?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 2
programme.desc: Ishizu, using the magic of her Millennium Necklace, has already seen the outcome of the duel – she will defeat Kaiba with her trap! How can Kaiba win when it’s already destined that he will lose? It’s time for Kaiba to change the future!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: As Marik’s evil grows, Ishizu reveals the secrets of her bloodline: How did Marik transform from a kind child into a power-hungry tyrant out for world domination? Can Yugi save Marik from the edge of darkness, or is he already beyond salvation?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 1
programme.desc: With their previous pact broken, Bakura duels Marik for the right to control the Millennium Rod and the Millennium Ring, and the loser will be trapped inside the Shadow Realm forever! To tip the odds, Bakura gains an unexpected ally in the form of… another Marik?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 2
programme.desc: Bakura and good Marik summon The Winged Dragon of Ra, ready to blast and banish evil Marik into the Shadow Realm! But The Winged Dragon of Ra has more than one special ability, and evil Marik knows how to use them all!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: As Kaiba’s blimp speeds towards KaibaCorp Island for the final rounds of the Battle City Tournament, the ship is hijacked by a mysterious boy named Noah and his henchmen – five familiar foes from Yugi and Kaiba’s past who are out for revenge! With the power of cyberspace on Noah’s side, Yugi and friends are trapped inside a new and dangerous Duel Monsters game!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Noah displays the power of his virtual world by splitting up Yugi’s gang and flinging them into the far reaches of his self-created universe! The first to duel under the all-new Deck Master System is Yugi against Big 1 Gansley’s Deepsea Warrior! Can Yugi master the complex new rules, or will the rules master him?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi faces off against Gansley, in the form of "Deepsea Warrior", but struggles with the complexities of the dueling field and the new rules. Tea faces peril from a vicious tribe of cyclopses while Kaiba and Mokuba are brought to a setting similar to their old orphanage.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi's strategy is hindered by Gansley's Deck Master ability. Tristan and Duke face a mean dinosaur to save Serenity. Meanwhile, Kaiba and Mokuba confront painful visions of their miserable childhood, but within the heartache may lurk the key to Noah's true intentions.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Téa is led by a penguin to Crump, in the form of Nightmare Penguin, who challenges her to a duel. She learns immediately that dueling in the virtual realm differs starkly from her previous duels, and starts to succumb to the virtual playing field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite gaining a lead with Maha Vailo, Téa falls behind as Crump begins an assault on her life points, causing the ice around her to grow. With the help of her Deck Master, Dark Magician Girl, and Yugi's Dark Magician, Téa gains enough confidence to win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey faces the Big 5's lawyer, Johnson, in a courtroom duel. Joey pulls an early lead with his Deck Master, Flame Swordsman, but Johnson's Deck Master, Judge Man, has abilities of his own.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey attempts to pull through with several luck-based cards, but Johnson's cheating tactics ruin all his chances, until an angry Noah puts a stop to him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Tristan, Duke and Serenity duel Nesbitt, the Big 5's mechanical expert. Serenity's lack of experience with the game and Nesbit's powerful machine monsters create a tragic end for Tristan.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With Tristan gone and Serenity in shock, Duke attempts to defeat Nesbitt by himself. But when Orgoth the Relentless is destroyed by his Perfect Machine King, Duke tries to help Serenity regain confidence in her abilities. The two later remember Tristan's face down card, hoping it will help them win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: As Nesbitt (in Tristan's body) kidnaps Mokuba, Kaiba is forced to duel Lector, the former assistant to his stepfather. For Lector, the duel is personal, as he plans to take what he believes is rightfully his—KaibaCorp. Meanwhile, Tristan rejoins the group; his friends do not recognize him, since his mind has been downloaded into a mechanical monkey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With Lector's Jinzo Deck Master destroying all of Kaiba's traps, Imperial Order destroying all his spell cards, and Lector's unreachable Satellite Cannon striking from space, Kaiba doesn't seem to stand a chance. Mokuba's unwavering faith in Kaiba keeps him believing that his brother will pull out with a victory, but Noah has plans to ruin their brotherhood.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi, Kaiba, and Tea are separated from the others as the Big 5 (minus Nesbitt) plan to take their bodies anyway. As Noah tortures Kaiba by brainwashing Mokuba, he reveals his true identity as Gozaboro Kaiba's biological son.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Merger of the Big Five — Part 1
programme.desc: Noah gives the Big Five one last chance to redeem themselves in a five-on-two tag team duel where Yugi and Joey take on the entire Big Five, who are using Tristan's body.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Merger of the Big Five — Part 2
programme.desc: The Big 5 attempt various strategies of victory, with the aim of eliminating Joey first. However, their poor teamwork soon puts Yugi and Joey ahead. Lector then calls their most powerful monster to the field, the Five Head Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Merger of the Big Five — Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey are forced to use their strongest monsters to take down the Five-Headed Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba and Noah duel for full control of KaibaCorp, but Noah's revelations and constant manipulation of the playing field complicate things for Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Noah's Shinato's Ark puts Kaiba in a difficult position, as he scrambles to find a winning strategy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba regains control of the duel, but Noah brings a brainwashed Mokuba out to hinder his plans. After finally breaking through to Mokuba, Kaiba tries to embrace his brother before Noah, jealous over their close relationship, turns them to stone.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Enraged at Noah's cruel games, Yugi takes over for Kaiba and duels Noah with only 400 life points.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi's efforts to win the duel are further complicated by Noah, who turns all of his friends into stone statues, leaving Yugi feeling alone and without hope.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Gozaboro Kaiba reveals himself and plans to virtualize the entire world to create a digital kingdom. With Noah's unlikely aid, Yugi and the others must escape while fending off memories from the past.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Using Mokuba's body, Noah escapes and sets the virtual world to self-destruct. But Mokuba's kindness breaks through his heart, and he tries to set the others free. Meanwhile, Kaiba duels Gozaboro, who summons a seemingly unstoppable monster—Exodia Necross.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ami Marik destroys the computers in the control room, disabling the controls for the self-destruct mechanism, which turns the situation desperate. Meanwhile, Kaiba defeats Gozoboro Kaiba, and he and Yugi rush to the exit before the virtual world explodes. Noah erases Gozoboro's files and releases his mind, and finally makes peace with his family, and prepares for the destruction of the virtual world.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and the others arrive at KaibaCorp Island and The Battle City Finals resume. To decide who will duel whom, the four duelists--Yugi, Joey, Kaiba, and Marik-- face each other in a four-way duel in the Duel Tower.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Gongenzaka and Sawatari fight against the mysterious Kaito, who believes them to be agents of Academia. As he summons his fearsome Galaxy Eyes Cipher Dragon, Yuto notes that something has changed in Kaito.

programme.desc: Kaito begins a merciless assault against Yuya with his powerful Galaxy Eyes deck. With Yuto's spirit on his side, Yuya tries to match Kaito's indomitable spirit with both Odd Eyes Pendulum Dragon and Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya and the others meet the Xyz Resistance, who discuss how Heartland fell to ruin and Yusho's mysterious connection to them. Elsewhere, in the Fusion Dimension, Yuzu flees Academia soldiers when someone unexpected comes to her rescue.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma searches for the second Mythyrian Number and ends up finding an old nemesis who is out for revenge!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Alito’s back in the ring to take down Yuma, but a fair fight isn’t in the cards when Alito has one of Yuma’s friends in his corner!

programme.desc: Nistro’s under Alito’s control, and it’s up to Yuma and Dextra to free him! Can this tag team duo bob and weave their way past Alito’s attacks, or will this Barian knock out any chances they have of winning?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho explains what happened during his disappearance to Yuzu while in the Fusion Dimension. Back in Heartland, Yuya comes across an angry youth with a grudge against his Dueltaining style as Yuto refuses to stand by any longer.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: An escapee from the underground brings word to Yuya on how to take control of the Friendship Cup!

programme.desc: Shay’s duel with Dennis turns into a battle of wits when he tries to force Dennis to reveal his dark secret

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
